garment_meadow.label: Meadow linen tunic
garment_meadow.note: Plain linen tunic: hem to z 0.40 with a side flare, patch pockets, laced neck.

garment_harbor.label: Harbor sailor blouse
garment_harbor.note: Sailor-collar blouse: square back collar, striped V front, red neck tie.

garment_rose.label: Rose cardigan
garment_rose.note: Open-front knit cardigan: cream tee showing, four buttons, ribbed hem and cuffs, two pockets.

garment_honey.label: Honey overalls
garment_honey.note: Bib overalls over a cream shirt: crossed straps, bib pocket, trouser legs with rolled cuffs.

garment_plum.label: Plum knit jumper
garment_plum.note: Chunky knit jumper: wide ribbed hem and cuffs, knit bands, roll neck.

garment_clay.label: Potter's apron
garment_clay.note: Potter's apron over a cream shirt: bib, pocket, neck loop, waist tie and bow behind.

garment_sage.label: Sage gardener vest
garment_sage.note: Gardener vest over a cream shirt: front placket and buttons, tool pocket with a trowel.

garment_midnight.label: Midnight overcoat
garment_midnight.note: Long overcoat to z 0.30 (mid-thigh): collar, lapels, double buttons, flap pockets; the flared hem clears a full stride.

garment_ivory.label: Sunday linen shirt
garment_ivory.note: Sunday shirt: collar points, button placket, chest pocket, buttoned cuffs.

garment_coral.label: Summer coral top
garment_coral.note: Sleeveless summer top (the game paints the arms bare): scoop neck, hem frill, flutter caps, dots.

garment_fern.label: Woodland jacket
garment_fern.note: Zipped woodland jacket: hood lying down behind the neck, flap pockets, leaf patches.

garment_festival.label: Festival velvet jacket
garment_festival.note: Velvet festival jacket: gold hem and cuffs, three pairs of gold frogging, collar, flower trim.

garment_sky.label: Cloud puff-sleeve blouse
garment_sky.note: Puff-sleeve blouse: round ruffled collar with a bow, elastic cuffs, hem frill, embroidered cloud.

kid_sunny.label: Sunshine pinafore
kid_sunny.note: Sleeveless A-line pinafore with crossing straps and a bib pocket over a short puff-sleeve blouse (arms bare).

kid_rain.label: Puddle-jump coat
kid_rain.note: Hooded rain coat (hood resting at the back): three wooden toggles, flap pockets, yellow lining at cuffs and hood.

kid_berry.label: Berry cardigan
kid_berry.note: Open knit cardigan: five cream buttons, ribbed hem and cuffs, a pocket, cream tee.

kid_party.label: Festival dress
kid_party.note: Festival dress: bodice, puff sleeves, two scalloped skirt tiers ending above the knee, back bow, star trim (arms bare).
